parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

For information about how to obtain the abbreviation, see the `metricCategory` tag in the `Labels` response parameter of the [DescribeProjectMeta](~~114916~~) operation.

parameters.name: ContactGroups
parameters.description: The alert contact group.

parameters.name: Dimensions
parameters.description:
The first-level dimensions of the alert rule in the application group.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs, such as `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`.

parameters.name: EffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The effective period during which the alert rule takes effect.

parameters.name: EmailSubject
parameters.description: The subject of the alert email.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.ComparisonOperator
parameters.description:
The comparison operator for Critical-level alerts. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold.
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold.
- LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold.
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday.
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week.
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week.
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period.
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Statistics
parameters.description:
The statistical method for Critical-level alerts. Separate multiple statistical methods with commas (,).

The value of this parameter is determined by the `Statistics` column that corresponds to the `MetricName` of the specified Alibaba Cloud service, such as Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For information about how to obtain the value, see [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Threshold
parameters.description: The threshold for Critical-level alerts.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Times
parameters.description: The retry count for Critical-level alerts.

parameters.name: ExtraDimensionJson
parameters.description:
The second-level or third-level dimensions of the alert rule in the application group.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs, such as `port:80` and `/dev/xvda:d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****`.

If the first-level dimension is `{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`, the second-level dimension is the cloud disk of the instance: `{"/dev/xvda":"d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****"}`.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The application group ID.

For information about how to obtain the application group ID, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The detection period of the alert rule. Unit: seconds.

> Keep the detection period consistent with the data reporting period. If the detection period is shorter than the data reporting period, alerts may not be triggered due to insufficient data.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description:
The tags of the alert rule.

Tags are included in alert notifications.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the alert rule.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the alert rule.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The metric name.

For information about how to obtain the metric name, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the namespace, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: NoDataPolicy
parameters.description:
The processing method when no monitoring data is found. Valid values:
- KEEP_LAST_STATE (default): No action is performed.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: An alert whose content is "Insufficient Data" is triggered.
- OK: The status is considered normal.

parameters.name: NoEffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The time range during which the alert rule is ineffective.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description:
The advanced settings.

Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}. Example: {"NotSendOK":true}. This specifies whether to send alert recovery notifications. The key is NotSendOK, and the value is true (do not send) or false (send, which is the default).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The reporting period of monitoring data.

The value of `Period` is 60 or a multiple of 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The alert rule ID.

- To create an alert rule for the application group, enter the alert rule ID.

- To modify a specified alert rule in the application group, obtain the alert rule ID. For information about how to obtain the alert rule ID, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description:
The alert rule name.

- To create an alert rule for the application group, enter the alert rule name.

- To modify a specified alert rule in the application group, obtain the alert rule name. For information about how to obtain the alert rule name, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

parameters.name: SilenceTime
parameters.description:
The mute period during which CloudMonitor does not repeatedly send alert notifications for the same metric.

Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400.

parameters.name: Webhook
parameters.description:
The callback URL to which a request is sent when an alert is triggered.

Enter a URL that is accessible over the Internet. CloudMonitor sends a POST request to push alert information to this URL. Only the HTTP protocol is supported.
